propositions: Natural fold enumerates and retires orphan events while citing their uuids in the new snapshot, but positional replay skips them, causing the orphan effect to be permanently lost while fsck incorrectly reports clean.

The fold must exclude un-cited pre-snapshot events (orphans per fsck definition) from retirement and source_event_uuids citation, leaving them live so that the ORPHAN_EVENT signal and repair window survive indefinitely.
The shared orphan predicate (anchored to the latest prior snapshot in the fold set) must be extracted and reused by both fold and fsck to prevent definition drift between the two tools.

Pre-snapshot foldable candidates must be deferred from the fold until their governing snapshot itself becomes foldable, preventing a pre-snapshot SNAPSHOT from being written and then positionally buried.
The --repair-snapshots path must apply the same _AUTO_RECOVER vs _HUMAN_TRIAGE routing as --repair to prevent routing parity drift and ensure human-triage orphans block whole-ticket rebuild.
